caption_en: TEST RENDER, not for posting. 15 of 26 UN General Assembly condemnations in 2025 went to one country.

sources.label: UN Watch, UNGA resolutions on Israel vs rest of world

lines.line: Fifteen out of twenty-six U.N. condemnations. One country.
Every year, the General Assembly votes on who to condemn. Let's watch the scoreboard.
Iran, North Korea, Myanmar: one each.
Sudan, the world's largest displacement crisis: zero.
And Israel: fifteen. More than the rest of the world combined.
Now let's make it fair. Per ten million people.
Russia: under half a condemnation. Israel: almost fifteen.
That's over a thousand times the rest of the world.
Israel's war in Gaza deserves scrutiny, like any war.
But fifteen to eleven isn't scrutiny. It's a pattern.
So next time someone quotes the U.N., remember:
